focus.title: 美国拟扩大对华半导体设备出口管制，欧盟跟进芯片法案补贴细则
focus.summary: 本周，美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）预告将修订《出口管理条例》，进一步限制对华出口先进半导体制造设备，涵盖深紫外光刻机及特定沉积设备。欧盟委员会同步发布《欧洲芯片法案》第二阶段补贴申请指南，要求获补贴企业承诺在欧优先供应。同时，七国集团财长会议声明重申对俄制裁并拟加强次级制裁执行。趋势显示，技术出口管制与供应链本地化并行，中国出海企业需加快合规体系升级及替代技术布局。
focus.source: 来源：美国联邦公报预告（2026年6月16日）、欧盟委员会公告（6月17日）、G7财长会议公报（6月18日）· 本周汇总
focus.title_en: U.S. Plans to Expand Export Controls on Semiconductor Equipment to China; EU Follows with Chip Act Subsidy Rules
focus.summary_en: This week, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) previewed amendments to the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) to further restrict exports of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China, including deep ultraviolet lithography systems and certain deposition equipment. The European Commission simultaneously released the second-phase subsidy application guidelines under the European Chips Act, requiring beneficiaries to prioritize supply within Europe. Additionally, the G7 finance ministers' meeting statement reiterated sanctions on Russia and proposed strengthening secondary sanctions enforcement. The trend indicates parallel technology export controls and supply chain localization, urging Chinese overseas enterprises to accelerate compliance upgrades and alternative technology deployment.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Federal Register preview (June 16, 2026), European Commission announcement (June 17), G7 Finance Ministers' communiqué (June 18) · compiled this week

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁庭裁定中企与东南亚合资方股权回购纠纷，明确不可抗力条款适用标准
case.summary: 本周，新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）就一起中国科技企业与东南亚合资方的股权回购纠纷作出裁决，认定新冠疫情及当地政策变动不构成合同约定的不可抗力，因合资协议未明确列举该类事件。仲裁庭强调，不可抗力条款的适用需严格依据合同文本，且主张方须证明事件直接导致履约不能。该案对中国出海企业启示：合资协议中应明确不可抗力范围，并设置灵活退出机制。
case.source: 来源：SIAC裁决书摘要（2026年6月15日发布）
case.title_en: SIAC Rules on Share Buyback Dispute Between Chinese Company and SE Asian Joint Venture Partner, Clarifying Force Majeure Standards
case.summary_en: This week, the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) ruled on a share buyback dispute between a Chinese tech company and its Southeast Asian joint venture partner, holding that the COVID-19 pandemic and local policy changes did not constitute force majeure under the contract, as the joint venture agreement did not explicitly list such events. The tribunal emphasized that force majeure clauses must be strictly interpreted based on contractual text, and the claiming party must prove the event directly caused performance impossibility. The case advises Chinese overseas enterprises to clearly define force majeure scope in joint venture agreements and establish flexible exit mechanisms.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区发布跨境数据流动标准合同指引，深圳前海试点数据出境绿色通道
policy.summary: 本周，广东省互联网信息办公室联合港澳相关部门发布《粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动标准合同（试行）》，明确个人信息和重要数据出境的合同条款要求，涵盖数据分类、安全评估、违约责任等。同时，深圳前海蛇口自贸片区启动数据出境“绿色通道”试点，对符合条件的企业简化审批流程。此举旨在促进大湾区数据要素高效流通，为跨境贸易、金融科技等场景提供合规路径。企业应尽快对照指引修订数据合规制度。
policy.source: 来源：广东省网信办、港澳相关部门联合发布（2026年6月17日）
policy.title_en: Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Issues Standard Contract Guidelines for Cross-Border Data Flow; Qianhai Pilots Fast-Track for Data Exports
policy.summary_en: This week, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province, together with relevant Hong Kong and Macao authorities, issued the "Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Standard Contract for Cross-Border Data Flow (Trial)", specifying contractual requirements for the transfer of personal information and important data, including data classification, security assessment, and breach of contract liability. Meanwhile, the Qianhai Shekou Free Trade Zone launched a "green channel" pilot for data export, simplifying approval processes for qualified enterprises. This move aims to facilitate efficient data flow within the Greater Bay Area, providing a compliance pathway for cross-border trade, fintech, and other scenarios. Enterprises should promptly update their data compliance systems in line with the guidelines.
policy.source_en: Source: Joint release by Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao authorities (June 17, 2026)

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应建立出口管制与数据合规双重防线，关注下周欧盟数字税立法动态
analysis.summary: 综合本周动向，技术出口管制与数据跨境流动规则同步收紧，出海企业面临“合规双线”压力。建议：一是立即梳理供应链中涉及美国原产技术或设备的环节，评估EAR修订影响并储备替代方案；二是依据大湾区数据合同指引，完成数据出境合同修订及安全评估申报。下周重点关注：欧盟委员会拟于6月22日公布数字服务税立法草案，或对跨境电商及数字服务企业产生重大税负影响，建议提前测算成本并调整业务架构。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师 · 律连全球涉外法律团队
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: Overseas enterprises must build dual defenses of export control and data compliance; watch EU digital tax legislation next week
analysis.summary_en: Given this week's developments, technology export controls and cross-border data flow rules are simultaneously tightening, putting overseas enterprises under 'dual compliance pressure.' Recommendations: first, immediately review supply chain links involving U.S.-origin technology or equipment, assess the impact of EAR amendments, and prepare alternative solutions; second, follow the Greater Bay Area data contract guidelines to revise data export contracts and submit security assessment filings. Next week, focus on: the European Commission is expected to publish a draft digital services tax legislation on June 22, which may significantly impact tax burdens for cross-border e-commerce and digital service enterprises. Advance cost estimation and business restructuring are advised.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao · iGlobal Law Team
